# HAPPY CODING

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

md_files <- list.files("random-files/coding-related/", pattern = "\\.md$", full.names = TRUE)
info <- file.info(md_files)
files <- rownames(info)[order(info$ctime, decreasing = TRUE)]
for (f in files) {
  name <- basename(f)
  display <- sub("\\.md$", "", name)
  cat(sprintf("- [%s](%s)\n", display, f))
}
```
